notes:
Summary: Copperfield is a mid-enterprise SaaS player powering support for several ecommerce customers. Primary goal: reduce live-agent transfers by 25-40% via a RAG-based support assistant + ticket deflection. They care deeply about top-5 result quality (explicit business metric) and tight tail latency for reranking.

POC scope: build a RAG pipeline over their combined KB (approx 5M documents after de-dup/segmentation). Two-phase: 1) embeddings + nearest-neighbor retrieval to surface ~50 candidates; 2) lightweight neural reranker to pick top-5 within 150ms p99 for the rerank step. End-to-end target: sub-400ms p99 for a single query at baseline 12 qps.

Performance / scale asks:
- Index size: target 5M doc vectors, nightly incremental indexing, daily full refresh window.
- QPS: baseline 12 sustained + spikes to 50 for flash events.
- Latency SLOs: 400ms p99 end-to-end, 150ms p99 reranker slice.
- Cost sensitivity: target $0.01-$0.03 per user query (incl retrieval + rerank) to keep unit economics for self-serve customers.

Model & infra preferences:
- Prefer quantized open models for rerank (Mistral/MPT-family or optimized Llama2 variants).
- Want dedicated GPU pools for reranker; retrieval can be served from VPC-hosted vector DB (on-prem or cloud VPC).
- KV / prefix caching desirable to keep rerank latency low; interested in Redwood's caching recommendations.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must pass security questionnaire (attached Drive doc). Require SSO SAML, audit logs, KMS integration, and EU residency for certain customer data.
- Quote from security lead: "No SaaS endpoint for PII replication unless encrypted and resident in EU". They pushed for Private deployment or Dedicated with strict VPC peering.

POC success criteria (agreed):
- Top-5 rerank accuracy (human-eval) >= baseline internal reranker + 8% absolute improvement on deflection prompts.
- Rerank p99 <= 150ms at 12 qps sustained.
- Cost per query <= $0.03.

Open items / next actions:
- SE to provide perf estimate matrix for 5M docs + 12 qps (expected GPU sizing + nativity of batching).
- Redwood infra team to propose Dedicated configuration + burst plan.
- Customer to complete security questionnaire and provide list of EU-resident orgs.

Quick CRM shorthand: POC -> evaluation. heavy on latency/cost tradeoff. customer leans private/Dedicated. Follow-up: Marco to send perf matrix and cost model by 2026-03-15.
